message.content:
This vertical editorial magazine cover features the red word "TEMPO" across the upper third, with a small superscript "53" to its right. The illustration below shows two caricature-like figures—a man in a light blue long-sleeved shirt and a woman in a red long-sleeved garment—pulling ropes. The man is on the left, leaning forward with his feet braced, while the woman is on the right, also leaning forward and gripping a rope. Both figures appear to be exerting significant physical force. Several thick ropes are tied around a large, grey, boxy structure with many dark rectangular windows and a curved, dome-like roof. This building sits in the background, angled slightly.

The text "MOTOR ANGKET PEMILU CURANG" appears in white capital letters on the lower right side, followed by a smaller paragraph of Indonesian text. At the top, two smaller headlines read "Pembesar Tambang Timah Ilegal H.64" and "Pontang-panting Anggaran Makan Siang Gratis H.76". The bottom right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, the date "11-17 MARET 2024", and price information. The overall color palette is muted, with grey, green, and red tones.
